headline: Entertainment license, vendor permits for Holiday Happenings at Charlotte Forten Park, and a one-day liquor license at 12 Hawthorne Blvd.
summary: Salem Main Streets is the applicant for both Holiday Happenings requests, which run through December 31, 2026. A one-day liquor license for a Woman’s Friend Society event on December 11, with 35 people, is also listed.
items: Entertainment license for Holiday Happenings at Charlotte Forten Park
Vendor permits for Holiday Happenings at Charlotte Forten Park, up to 20 vendors at a time
One-day liquor license at 12 Hawthorne Blvd. on December 11, 2026

AGENDA 
 
1. Application for Entertainment License to operate Holiday Happenings programming at 
Charlotte Forten Park 289 Derby Street, Salem.  Dates:  November 27, 2026 thru 
December 31, 2026.  Applicant:  Salem Main Streets.  Examples of entertainment include 
a small Nutcracker performance, limited amplification small bands and acoustic 
performances. 
2. Application for Vendor Permits for Holiday Happenings programming at Charlotte 
Forten Park 289 Derby Street, Salem.  Dates:  November 27, 2026 thru December 31, 
2026.  Applicant:  Salem Main Streets.  Up to 20 vendors at a time will participate and 
vendors will largely be local community groups.
